title: Close nonlinear and adaptive centre sharing at the fresh-information floor (no new κ)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Scoped proof + pricing screen (negative result); no new κ, selected record unchanged.**

Package: `research/centre-nonlinear-fresh-floor/`.

- **Theorem 1.** Under the premises of `research/centre-history-innovation`, any fresh observation that is continuous, or semialgebraic (finitely many branches built from `+ - ×`, division by nonzero values including the dyadic `/2, /4`, comparisons and adaptive reads that may depend on the history or on earlier fresh reads), still needs **at least 8d complex coordinates** per future owner, the same as the linear floor. Proof: on a subspace `V ⊂ ker H` the history vanishes and `Q|_V` is bijective, so the fresh observation must be injective on a real `16d`-dimensional set; invariance of domain (continuous case) or semialgebraic dimension preservation (branching case) gives `n ≥ 16d`.
- **Theorem 2.** On a finite b-bit grid the only escape is Kronecker packing, which conserves bits (widths sum to `≥ 16db`, attained exactly; one bit less collides). In the rank-mass model this keeps the coverage mass `72w + 64` and the deficit `w − 64`.
- **Screen.** Regrouping the 64 centre mass into larger children (bounding every packing) raises the complex-local-word ceiling by at most **+0.67%** (`x1.006721`, fractional rank-72), before guard bits, carries, unpacking or hosting are charged. The card's two-call sharing budget (`x1.90`) needs the fresh information halved, which Theorems 1–2 exclude.

Remaining obligations / not covered: all premises of centre-history-innovation are inherited (native common-frame, full-space cover view, one future owner, call 10); the step from 8d coordinates to 64 rank-mass units is #3918's rank-8 carrier premise, unchanged by nonlinearity; a terminal-only consumer that never forms the internal call-10 query is a changed contract and stays open.

## Task and overlap

Card `centre-path-sharing`, priority revision 7, base `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`. Scope **refined**: answers method 2 (copied-information lower bound) for the nonlinear/adaptive fresh-data interfaces.

Closes the case listed as not established in #3873 ("a lower bound against nonlinear or adaptive algorithms") and the fresh nonlinear-observation case left open by centre-history-innovation (including its "mutable eight-slot cache with fresh reads"). Nearest work inspected: #3075, #3120, #3147, #3151, #3291, #3548, #3873, #3918, #3948, #1888, and the nonlinear copy floors #785/#888 (which price nonlinear messages under an explicit additive-width premise on E8 lines, not the centre path). I found no nonlinear fresh-observation centre bound; no novelty guarantee.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/centre-nonlinear-fresh-floor/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-nonlinear-fresh-floor
```

CPython 3.12 on Windows: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result` (normal and `-O` replays), `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` with `--check-source-history`. About 35 s, mostly the unchanged predecessor replay (`PASS_CENTRE_HISTORY_INNOVATION sha256=8edf9aec…`, bound to its RESULT.json).

Finite checks: Kronecker packing sharpness on six small grids; exact rational ceiling brackets via `research/complex-local-word-ceiling/ceiling.py` with mass conservation asserted. Controls: halved centre information reproduces `x1.901107`; a rank-73 child, a mass-losing pack and a corrupted predecessor digest are rejected. Theorems 1–2 are proof arguments in the README, not finite checks. No selected cold replay or formal-kernel review.

## Credit

Builds on Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`)'s centre-history-innovation and its lineage, Clear1nsight's centre-causal-tangent (#3873), Douglas Colkitt's complex-local-word ceiling, the nonlinear copy-floor line (#703, #785, #814, #888) and the centre-sharing budgets (#1791, #1888, #3075, #3548, #3948). Substantial Claude (Anthropic) assistance in proof, code and prose; no independent human review.

## Open next questions

In the package README and TASK.json: (1) can a terminal-only consumer avoid forming the internal call-10 query (first step: test the 112 kernel witnesses against a stated terminal map); (2) does 8d fresh coordinates force 64 rank-mass units for carriers other than rank-8 channels (ideal gain capped here at +0.67%).
